cases.title: Inline superscript and font style preservation
cases.description: Covers superscript markers, bold/emphasis spans, and font-size changes inside the same visual row.

cases.title: Human reading order for multi-column pages
cases.description: Covers pages where visual order differs from naive top-to-bottom, left-to-right extraction.

cases.title: Non-text object understanding
cases.description: Covers figures, charts, lines, rectangles, and other non-text objects that must not be dropped.

cases.title: Multi-line paragraph grouping
cases.description: Covers paragraphs split across multiple visual rows that should become one paragraph block.

cases.title: Table structure normalization
cases.description: Covers tables with headers, row/column relationships, merged cells, and multi-line cells.

cases.title: RAG/RLM-ready chunking
cases.description: Covers layout-aware chunking with heading path, page references, bbox references, and source block ids.

cases.title: Footnote marker and body linking
cases.description: Covers superscript markers and footnote body text that must remain connected after parsing.

cases.title: Table of contents linking
cases.description: Covers visual TOC entries and PDF outline items linked to target headings or pages.

cases.title: Image and chart asset extraction
cases.description: Covers embedded images and chart candidates that must be normalized into Pillow-compatible assets.

cases.title: Three-column newsletter reading order
cases.description: Three text columns under a full-width title; human order reads each column fully.

cases.title: Sidebar beside main text column
cases.description: Narrow full-height sidebar next to the main column must not interleave with it.

cases.title: Table continued across pages with repeated header
cases.description: One logical table split over two pages, header repeated on the continuation page.

cases.title: Table with a merged header cell
cases.description: Header cell visually spans two columns; grid must stay consistent.

cases.title: Financial statement table
cases.description: Thousands separators, parenthesized negatives, and indented account rows.

cases.title: Repeated page header and footer
cases.description: Confidential header and page-number footer repeat on every page and must be classified as page furniture.

cases.title: Mixed Traditional Chinese and English text
cases.description: CJK and Latin text in the same paragraphs; grouping and punctuation handling must hold.

cases.title: Long table of contents with outline
cases.description: Ten TOC entries plus a PDF outline linked to numbered section headings.

cases.title: Image-only scanned page requiring OCR
cases.description: Scanned page with no native text; OCR must produce flagged text blocks.
